messages:
maria: Canary perf gate tripped after merge #3382 — shortseq decode p95 jumped ~40%. Observed on canary cluster in eu-west-1.
jon: Confirm. Dashboard shows p95 before: 42ms -> after: 59ms for seq<=64 workloads.
siva: My quick profiling suggests `kernel_selector` chose `attn_fused_v2` instead of `attn_prefetch` when KV hit rate > 70% and batch_size < 8. Looks like the warmup/metering heuristics flipped.
ankit: Can you paste the flame sample? Also CI perf job showed the same regression, so not just noisy canary.
perf-bot: Perf CI: job/serving-e2e/canary/step5 FAILED gate (p95 delta +40%).
maria: Flame snippet from perf run:
```
flamegraph top:
- decode_loop 100% (p95)
  - step_attention 70%
    - attn_fused_v2::forward 58%
    - kv_prefetch 5%
  - io_wait 10%
```
jon: Interesting — attn_fused_v2 is heavier on memory copies when KV cache is hot because it doesn't use the new KV-prefetch path.
siva: Reproducer on my laptop: load small batch workload w/ KV warm; run `./run_local_bench --model small --seq 32 --kv_hit_rate 0.8 --concurrency 16` and you'll see p95 up.
ankit: Bisect candidate: merge 3382 introduced `kernel_selector::score` change. Recommend quick bisect between 3379..3385.
maria: I'll run bisect on canary now; if it's 3382 we should either revert the selector change or gate it behind `--prefer-prefetch-for-kv` flag.
perf-bot: Canary bisect started by maria at 2024-09-12T12:38:00Z
jon: If revert needed, do a tiny revert PR that pins selector heuristic to the old threshold and run canary again.
siva: Also add a unit test in kselector_test that simulates high KV hit and small batch to prevent regression.
maria: Action items: (1) bisect (maria), (2) repro + test (siva), (3) quick revert PR template (jon). Will update thread.
jon: :thumbsup:
